title: Bootstrap Inference under General Two-way Clustering with Serially and Spatially Dependent Common Effects
summary: This paper develops bootstrap procedures for inference in linear regression models with two-way clustered data. We characterize the estimator's asymptotic behavior in five mutually exclusive and exhaustive regimes: three Gaussian and two non-Gaussian.
